Written by `npx tsx packages/engine/lint-format-history.ts --accept --note "..."`, which appends a row for a version not yet recorded and never rewrites a row another branch wrote. Two PRs that take the same version each append a row here, so they conflict; a merge that keeps both rows fails DUPLICATE, and one that keeps one fails SHAPE (#4458, #4330).
